title: Evaluating Large Language Models with Psychometrics

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the 'Dimensions of Culture Questionnaire' from the GLOBE project to assess the models' cultural orientations and tendencies across dimensions such as collectivism, assertiveness, and power distance.

Evaluating the robustness of model responses by shuffling the order of options in multiple-choice questions to determine if the models systematically favor specific option positions (e.g., always choosing option A).
